source_text: Major medical organizations reflect these tensions: the American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP) 2012 policy (reaffirmed without major revision as of 2022) states preventive benefits outweigh risks but stops short of universal recommendation, deferring to parental choice amid cultural and ethical variances.
